notes.title: Gray Destiny - Indie Precision Platformer
notes.content:
Indie game developer VisualPath is thrilled to announce the launch of their precision platformer, "Gray Destiny," on Steam. The game is set to be released on August 14, 2023, and promises an exhilarating gaming experience for players seeking challenging and immersive gameplay.

[previewyoutube=r0Np4iE7DDE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]About Gray Destiny[/h3]

In "Gray Destiny," players embark on an epic adventure through a beautifully crafted world filled with intricate platforming challenges and mesmerizing environments. Guided by fate, they take on the role of a mysterious protagonist on a quest to restore balance to the realm, facing countless obstacles and enemies along the way. The game's tight controls and carefully designed levels will test players' skills, offering an engaging and rewarding experience for seasoned platformer enthusiasts and newcomers.

[h3]Key Features[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Precision Platforming[/b]: Master the art of precision as you navigate through intricate levels, testing your timing and dexterity to the limit.
[*] [b]Captivating Atmosphere[/b]: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world with hand-drawn graphics and an evocative soundtrack that complements the gameplay.
[*] [b]Challenging Puzzles[/b]: Encounter mind-bending puzzles that will require sharp thinking and quick reflexes to overcome.
[*] [b]Engaging Storyline[/b]: Unravel the secrets of the Gray Destiny world and discover the true meaning behind your journey.
[/list]

[h3]Pricing and Availability[/h3]

"Gray Destiny" will be available for purchase on Steam at the affordable price of $3.99. To celebrate the launch, players can take advantage of a limited-time 15% discount, making it even more accessible during the initial release period.

[h3]About VisualPath[/h3]

VisualPath is an independent game development studio dedicated to creating memorable and innovative gaming experiences. With a passion for storytelling and gameplay, the team strives to craft engaging titles that resonate with players worldwide.

[h3]Stay Updated[/h3]

To stay informed about "Gray Destiny" and receive updates from VisualPath, follow them on social media and visit their official website.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/596090?utm_source=lom-announcement

Developer Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44445059-VisualPath/

notes.title: Updates and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 27.08.2016[/h1]

- Fixed loop in Quest "Meet Andreas".
- Fixed entering the Cave without quest being started.
- Fixed Town Guard portrait not displaying properly.
- Added  guide text for Fishing minigame.
- Added instructions on Load Game message.
- Minor visual fixes.


[h1]Clarification[/h1]

The game does not try to install everytime, it just checks for the proper DLL files for DirectX. There is an incompatibility with some DirectX files that need to be checked and fixed on certain PCs.

[h1]Main Menu - DirectX Issue[/h1]
Run-time error '339' Component 'COMCTL32.OCX' or one of its dependencies not correctly registered.

For some reason, DirectX does not register files in the registry as it should on some versions of Windows. I am looking for a way to fix this for you from the DLL checking on Steam. This error is from DirectX and not from the game itself.

[b]We are sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused.[/b]

Have fun!

notes.title: Legend of Miro - Official Launch Today (22 August 2016)
notes.content:
We are happy to let everyone know that the official launch of Legend of Miro is going to be TODAY!

It has been a difficult journey, but we managed to get to this point.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/469980/

[h1]HOW IT ALL STARTED[/h1]
The main idea of the game was born after a brainstorming session in which we asked ourselves how can we make a different Indie RPG. We wanted to create something that was not done before, with new storytelling and interactivity elements, but remain an Indie game at its core.

We came to the conclusion that what all the Indie RPG games are missing is the interactivity, so we decided to approach the game in a different manner that developers normally do.

[h1]THE PAST 6 MONTHS[/h1]
What did these past six months mean for us? I don’t think I can sum everything up in a few words. There were a lot of emotions, stress and disappointments, but also a lot of positive feelings like happiness, satisfaction and a sense of fulfillment. All of these contradictory feelings came almost on a daily basis during the 8-10 hours of daily development.

It was a though journey, but from our point of view, it was all worth it and we would do it all over again.
